logp.method_description: Partition coefficients were determined by the addition of fac-[99mTc(CO)3(L5)]+ (10 µL, ~5 MBq without decay correction) to an octanol/0.1 M PBS (pH 7.4) solution (1:1 v/v). The mixture was shaken for 3 min; then the layers were left to separate. An aliquot of the organic layer (0.9 mL octanol) was added to freshly prepared 0.1 M PBS (0.9 mL), and each phase was presaturated with the other phase and shaken for 3 min. The mixture was centrifuged (5 min, 13 200 rpm) and aliquots (0.5 mL) from the two separate layers (aqueous and organic) taken for analysis of the radioactive decay. All samples were prepared and measured in triplicate.
